entries.description: Declined to fix the width ceiling. The one-line repair changes a silicon-anchored module — bit-exactness anchors and Arty evidence keyed to current behaviour — for a width nobody requested. Fixing anchored RTL for a hypothetical is how anchors rot. Documented with its exact trigger in the header instead.

Validated the RTL literal scanner against a firing specimen BEFORE believing its '1 suspicious' output. After two instrument failures earlier today, a scan is not evidence until shown able to convict more than it did.

findings.description: LATENT WIDTH CEILING at 32 in the shipped reciprocal: reg [4:0] lb and lb = i[4:0] cap the leading-bit index at five bits. Safe at every format in play (12/16/20/24/32) but at WIDTH>=33 a bit at position 32 records as 0 and the seed scale goes wrong — silently, it computes rather than errors.

The @verify re-binding concern is NOT APPLICABLE to this kernel: kalman_filter.eml has no @verify contracts, and none of electronics_intake's 114 @verify files is on its path. Certification runs through the Lean theorems and silicon anchors. Closed as N/A, not as verified — it reopens if the chip pulls in a @verify-path kernel.
